授業科目の概要.講義題目: This course explores various interpersonal relationships and communication styles in Japanese society from a cross-cultural psychology perspective.
授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
This course is designed to help students develop practical skills for intercultural communication. The content is both substantial and engaging.
We warmly welcome the active participation of both international and Japanese students from all faculties.
The primary language of instruction will be English. However, during group discussions, students may also use Japanese or other languages, as well as dictionaries and other supportive tools.
As this course is offered for international students in the JTW Program, it will begin one week earlier than other KIKAN Education courses. The first class will be held during the fifth period on Thursday, April 2, in Room 5214 on the second floor of Building 5 (Center Zone) at Ito Campus.
Students other than those in the JTW Program are welcome to join the course from the second class onward.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 本講義では、異文化心理学の視点から、日本社会におけるさまざまな人間関係やコミュニケーションのあり方について考察する。講義を通して、こうしたコミュニケーション行動の背景にある心理的な原理を探り、誤解や文化的摩擦への対応について理解を深める。また、講義では異文化間の相互理解を促す姿勢を養うとともに、実践的な演習を通して効果的なコミュニケーションスキルを習得する。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This course examines various interpersonal relationships and communication styles in Japanese society from the perspective of cross-cultural psychology. Students will explore the psychological principles underlying communication behaviors and develop insights into addressing misunderstandings and cultural friction. Lectures will cultivate a mindset that fosters mutual understanding across cultures, while practical exercises will help students acquire effective communication skills.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: International students and Japanese students who are interested in intercultural communication　(Credit will be awarded only to international and Japanese undergraduate students.)
